verdict.rationale: A first-party GitHub repository (nottelabs/notte) publicly describes the product's agent and scripting capabilities, which suggests the source is readable. No evidence names a license or confirms it is open; one community comment wishing it were open source is general skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: an explicitly stated open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache/SSPL), clarity on whether the cloud platform or only the SDK/agent code is published, independent corroboration of open availability.
